can_do_statement: Can use the negative form with a wide range of regular and irregular verbs.

ontology.mental_model: Events explicitly marked as not having occurred in the past.
ontology.pedagogical_hook: Using 'did not' or 'didn't' to talk about what didn't happen.

positives: I didn't hesitate when they asked me.
They did not fully understand the consequences.
negatives: I don't hesitate when I'm asked.
She doesn't fully understand it.

can_do_statement: Can use the past simple with a range of subordinating conjunctions, including 'as soon as', 'before', 'if', 'once', 'since', 'so', 'until', 'when', 'while'.

ontology.mental_model: Connecting past events in time or condition.
ontology.pedagogical_hook: Using conjunctions like 'before' or 'once' with past tense verbs.

positives: Before I came here, I was happy.
Once he got inside, he searched.
negatives: Before I come here, I am happy.
Once he gets inside, he searches.

can_do_statement: Can use the past simple to order sequences of events in the past, in the context of narratives.

ontology.mental_model: Narrating a series of sequential events in the past.
ontology.pedagogical_hook: Using 'and' or 'and then' to link multiple past actions.

positives: He met a lot of new friends, and then got married.
We met at 9 and decided to go.
negatives: He meets a lot of friends and then gets married.
We meet at 9 and decide to go.

can_do_statement: Can use the past simple with 'wish (that)' to express regret that things are not different.

ontology.mental_model: Expressing desire for a present or future situation to be different.
ontology.pedagogical_hook: Using 'wish' followed by the past simple.

positives: I wish that you were here.
I wish weekends lasted five days.
negatives: I wish you the best of luck.
They wish to speak to you.

can_do_statement: Can use the past simple after 'if' to talk about the possible result of an imagined situation in the present or future.

ontology.mental_model: Hypothesizing about unreal or unlikely present/future conditions.
ontology.pedagogical_hook: Using the past simple after 'if' to imagine alternatives.

positives: If you wanted to do some activities, we could go.
It would be better if you spent some time here.
negatives: If you want to do some activities, we can go.
It will be better if you spend some time.

can_do_statement: Can use a range of time adjuncts with the past simple.

ontology.mental_model: Grounding an event in a specific past time frame.
ontology.pedagogical_hook: Using past simple alongside distinct time markers like 'yesterday' or 'last year'.

positives: I worked as a helper last summer.
It happened to me last year.
negatives: I am working as a helper this summer.
It happens to me every year.

can_do_statement: Can use 'yes/no', 'wh-', tag and negative question forms with a limited range of verbs.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: Using 'did' or 'didn't' to form a question.

positives: Did you receive my present?
Why didn't he call me?
negatives: Do you receive my present?
Why doesn't he call me?

guideword: FORM: INVERSION WITH 'NOT ONLY … BUT ALSO'
can_do_statement: Can use the inverted form of the past simple with auxiliary 'do', in the phrase 'not only … but also'.

ontology.mental_model: Adding rhetorical emphasis by fronting the negative particle.
ontology.pedagogical_hook: Inverting subject and auxiliary after 'Not only'.

positives: Not only did I find them, but also others.
Not only didn't we travel, but also we stayed.
negatives: I not only found them, but also others.
We not only travelled, but also stayed.

can_do_statement: Can use the past simple with 'I wondered' and 'I wanted' as politeness structures, when making polite requests and thanking.

ontology.mental_model: Using past tense forms to create social distance and sound more polite.
ontology.pedagogical_hook: Saying 'I wondered' or 'I wanted' to make a polite request.

positives: I wondered if you could introduce me.
First of all, I wanted to thank you.
negatives: I wonder if you could introduce me.
First of all, I want to thank you.

can_do_statement: Can use the past simple with 'did' for emphasis.

ontology.mental_model: Asserting truth or contrasting with an expectation.
ontology.pedagogical_hook: Using 'did' before the main verb for emphasis.

positives: We did reach the target figure.
It is true that it did rain during the day.
negatives: Did we reach the target figure?
I didn't reach the target figure.

can_do_statement: Can use 'yes/no', 'wh-', tag and negative question forms with a wide range of verbs.  ► Questions

ontology.mental_model: Requesting information about past events with a wide range of verbs.

positives: Did you spot the fact?
How did it turn out then?
negatives: Do you spot the fact?
How does it turn out then?

guideword: USE: COMPLEX ORDERING OF PAST EVENTS
can_do_statement: Can use the past simple to order sequences of events in the past in a complex way.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: Using forms like 'following' or 'after having' to order events.

positives: Following advice from a friend, I purchased the product.
After having discussed this, we came up with decisions.
negatives: I purchased the product.
We came up with decisions.

can_do_statement: Can use the past simple after 'if' as a politeness structure, especially in letters and emails.

ontology.mental_model: Mitigating requests by framing them as hypothetical scenarios.
ontology.pedagogical_hook: Using the past simple after 'if' in formal contexts like letters.

positives: I think it would be very helpful if I told you my own case.
I would be grateful if you gave me this job.
negatives: I think it will be very helpful if I tell you.
I will be grateful if you give me this job.

can_do_statement: Can use the past simple 'I thought' as a politeness structure to sound less direct.

ontology.mental_model: Using the past tense of think to soften statements.
ontology.pedagogical_hook: Using 'I thought' to make a suggestion sound less direct.

positives: I thought it would be a good idea.
I thought you might be interested.
negatives: I think it would be a good idea.
I think you might be interested.

can_do_statement: Can use the question form with a limited range of verbs.

ontology.mental_model: Inquiring about ongoing actions up to the present.

positives: Have you been thinking about it a lot?
What have you been doing?
negatives: Are you thinking about it a lot?
What were you doing?
